source.loadout/artifacts.toml:
[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/skills"
format = "tree"
category = "skills"
source = "skills/native/claude/skills"

[artifact.modes]
"probe/SKILL.md" = 420
"probe/run.sh" = 493

[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/CLAUDE.md"
format = "copy"
category = "instructions"
source = "instructions/native/claude/CLAUDE.md"
mode = 420
emit_empty = true

[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/settings.json"
format = "json"
order = ["model", "permissions", "hooks", "enabledPlugins", "env"]
emit_empty = true

[artifact.parts.settings]
source = "settings/native/claude/settings.json"

[artifact.parts.permissions]
source = "permissions/native/claude/settings.json"
keys = ["permissions"]

[artifact.parts.hooks]
source = "hooks/native/claude/settings.json"
keys = ["hooks"]

[artifact.parts.plugins]
source = "plugins/native/claude/settings.json"
keys = ["enabledPlugins", "extraKnownMarketplaces"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["codex"]
destination = "${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/AGENTS.md"
format = "copy"
category = "instructions"
source = "instructions/native/codex/AGENTS.md"
mode = 420
emit_empty = true

[[artifact]]
agents = ["codex"]
destination = "${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/config.toml"
format = "toml"
order = ["model"]
emit_empty = true
partial = true

[artifact.parts.settings]
source = "settings/native/codex/config.toml"

[artifact.parts.mcp]
source = "mcp/native/codex/config.toml"
keys = ["mcp_servers"]

[artifact.parts.plugins]
source = "plugins/native/codex/config.toml"
keys = ["plugins", "marketplaces"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["opencode"]
destination = "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/AGENTS.md"
format = "copy"
category = "instructions"
source = "instructions/native/opencode/AGENTS.md"
mode = 420
emit_empty = true

[[artifact]]
agents = ["opencode"]
destination = "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/opencode.json"
format = "json"
order = ["permission", "model"]
emit_empty = true

[artifact.parts.settings]
source = "settings/native/opencode/opencode.json"

[artifact.parts.permissions]
source = "permissions/native/opencode/opencode.json"
keys = ["permission"]

[artifact.parts.mcp]
source = "mcp/native/opencode/opencode.json"
keys = ["mcp"]

[artifact.parts.plugins]
source = "plugins/native/opencode/opencode.json"
keys = ["plugin"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["pi"]
destination = "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/AGENTS.md"
format = "copy"
category = "instructions"
source = "instructions/native/pi/AGENTS.md"
mode = 420
emit_empty = true

[[artifact]]
agents = ["pi"]
destination = "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/settings.json"
format = "json"
order = ["defaultModel"]
emit_empty = true
partial = true

[artifact.parts.settings]
source = "settings/native/pi/settings.json"

[artifact.parts.plugins]
source = "plugins/native/pi/settings.json"
keys = ["packages"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/hooks"
format = "tree"
category = "hooks"
source = "hooks/native/claude/hooks"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/commands"
format = "tree"
category = "instructions"
source = "instructions/native/claude/commands"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/mcp-permissions.json"
format = "json"
order = []

[artifact.parts.mcp-permissions]
source = "mcp-permissions/native/claude/mcp-permissions.json"
keys = ["allow", "ask", "deny"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["claude"]
destination = "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~}/.claude.json"
format = "json"
order = []
partial = true
emit_empty = false

[artifact.parts.mcp]
source = "mcp/native/claude/.claude.json"
keys = ["mcpServers"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["codex"]
destination = "${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/skills"
format = "tree"
category = "skills"
source = "skills/native/codex/skills"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["codex"]
destination = "${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/rules/permissions.rules"
format = "copy"
category = "permissions"
source = "permissions/native/codex/rules/permissions.rules"
mode = 420

[[artifact]]
agents = ["codex"]
destination = "${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/hooks.json"
format = "json"
order = []

[artifact.parts.hooks]
source = "hooks/native/codex/hooks.json"
keys = ["hooks"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["codex"]
destination = "${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/plugins"
format = "tree"
category = "plugins"
source = "plugins/native/codex/plugins"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["opencode"]
destination = "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/skills"
format = "tree"
category = "skills"
source = "skills/native/opencode/skills"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["opencode"]
destination = "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/plugins"
format = "tree"
category = "plugins"
source = "plugins/native/opencode/plugins"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["pi"]
destination = "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/skills"
format = "tree"
category = "skills"
source = "skills/native/pi/skills"

[artifact.modes]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["pi"]
destination = "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/extensions/pi-permission-system/config.json"
format = "json"
order = []

[artifact.parts.permissions]
source = "permissions/native/pi/extensions/pi-permission-system/config.json"
keys = ["$schema", "permission"]

[[artifact]]
agents = ["pi"]
destination = "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/extensions/loadout.ts"
format = "copy"
category = "hooks"
source = "hooks/native/pi/extensions/loadout.ts"
mode = 420

[[artifact]]
agents = ["pi"]
destination = "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/mcp.json"
format = "json"
order = []

[artifact.parts.mcp]
source = "mcp/native/pi/mcp.json"
keys = ["mcpServers"]
